name: Soda fountain glass
note: Wide flare for a float or a fizzy top with room for foam.
iceDisplacementNote: Solid ice only. No measured figure exists for this shape; cubed is copied from the Collins on this site, the nearest tall glass at the same capacity. Crushed is taken as 7% above cubed: loose crushed ice weighs about 593 to 640 kg per cubic metre against 917 for solid ice, roughly 65% solid, where loose cubes run about 61%.
